questions.question: Explain the event planning process.
questions.solution_html:
• The event planning process involves a series of steps to organise and conduct an event successfully.
  • It begins with setting objectives, identifying the target audience, preparing a budget, selecting the
  • venue and date, and developing a detailed plan. It also includes arranging resources, coordinating
  • with vendors, promoting the event, managing logistics, and ensuring proper execution. Finally, the
  • event is evaluated to measure its success and identify areas for improvement. / .
questions.final_answer: event is evaluated to measure its success and identify areas for improvement
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Evaluate the importance of partnerships in building entrepreneurial ecosystems.
questions.solution_html:
• Partnerships are important in building entrepreneurial ecosystems because they connect
  • entrepreneurs with investors, educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses.
  • They provide access to finance, knowledge, technology, skilled professionals, and market
  • opportunities. Partnerships also encourage innovation, resource sharing, networking, and business
  • growth. Therefore, strong partnerships help entrepreneurs overcome challenges, reduce risks, and
  • develop successful and sustainable businesses.
questions.final_answer: develop successful and sustainable businesses
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Discuss the major factors responsible for the continuous evolution of the media / landscape.
questions.solution_html:
• The media landscape continuously evolves due to technological advancements, changing audience
  • preferences, digitalisation, and globalisation. The growth of the internet, smartphones, and social
  • media has transformed the production, distribution, and consumption of media content. Economic
  • factors, advertising trends, competition, government regulations, and the emergence of new business
  • models also influence media development. Additionally, audience demand for instant, interactive
  • and personalised content encourages media organisations to adopt new technologies and platforms.
  • These factors contribute to the continuous transformation of the media industry. / .
questions.final_answer: These factors contribute to the continuous transformation of the media industry
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Apply campaign planning principles to design a basic promotional campaign for a / short film.
questions.solution_html:
• A promotional campaign for a short film begins by setting clear objectives, such as increasing
  • audience awareness and attracting viewers. The target audience is identified based on age, interests
  • and film preferences. A suitable budget and promotional schedule are prepared. Posters, trailers
  • teasers, and behind-the-scenes videos are created to generate interest. Social media platforms such
  • as Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook are used to promote the film. Film screenings, collaborations
  • with influencers, and press releases can further increase visibility. Finally, the campaign's success is
  • evaluated by measuring views, likes, shares, audience engagement, and screening attendance.
  • .
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Analyse the factors influencing media selection.
questions.solution_html:
• Media selection is influenced by several factors, including the target audience, advertising budget
  • campaign objectives, nature of the product, reach, frequency, and cost- effectiveness. The target
  • audience's age, interests, location, and media habits help determine the most suitable platform. Television
  • provides wide reach, newspapers offer detailed information, and social media enables interactive
  • communication. The campaign's duration, timing, and geographical coverage also affect media selection.
  • Therefore, choosing the right media helps organizations communicate effectively with their target audience
  • and achieve their advertising objectives.
questions.final_answer: and achieve their advertising objectives
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Analyse the major barriers faced by new entrepreneurs.
questions.solution_html:
• New entrepreneurs face several barriers when starting a business. Financial constraints make it
  • difficult to obtain capital, loans, and investments. Lack of experience and business knowledge
  • affects decision-making and management. Market competition creates challenges in attracting
  • customers and establishing a brand. Other barriers include limited access to technology, skilled
  • employees, and business networks. Government regulations, legal procedures, and economic
  • uncertainty can also delay business growth. These barriers can be overcome through proper
  • planning, financial management, training, innovation, and effective networking. / .
questions.final_answer: planning, financial management, training, innovation, and effective networking
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: How would you apply media budgeting?
questions.solution_html:
• Media budgeting can be applied by allocating funds to different media platforms according to the
  • campaign objectives, target audience, and available resources. First, the total advertising budget is
  • determined. Then, funds are distributed among television, radio, newspapers, and digital media based
  • on their reach, cost, and effectiveness. Expenses for content creation, production, and promotion are
  • also considered. Finally, the campaign's performance is monitored to ensure effective use of funds
  • and achieve maximum results within the budget. / .
questions.final_answer: and achieve maximum results within the budget
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Discuss the importance of human resources in media organizations.
questions.solution_html:
• Human resources are essential in media organizations because they manage employees and ensure
  • the smooth functioning of operations. They are responsible for recruiting skilled professionals
  • providing training, evaluating performance, and maintaining employee relations. Human resources
  • help journalists, editors, camera operators, and other media professionals work efficiently as a team.
  • They also handle salaries, workplace policies, and conflict resolution. Effective human resource
  • management improves productivity, creativity, employee satisfaction, and the overall performance of
  • media organizations. / .
questions.final_answer: media organizations
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Interpret the role of media planning.
questions.solution_html:
• Media planning plays a vital role in advertising by determining the right media platform, target
  • audience, timing, frequency, and budget for a campaign. It helps advertisers select suitable platforms
  • such as television, radio, newspapers, and digital media to reach the intended audience effectively.
  • Media planning ensures the optimum use of the advertising budget, increases audience reach
  • improves brand awareness, and avoids unnecessary expenditure. It also helps evaluate campaign
  • performance and achieve marketing objectives through effective communication. / .
questions.final_answer: performance and achieve marketing objectives through effective communication
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Explain how OTT platforms, artificial intelligence, virtual production and / immersive media can influence film production and distribution.
questions.solution_html:
• OTT platforms, artificial intelligence (AI), virtual production, and immersive media have
  • significantly transformed film production and distribution. OTT platforms such as Netflix and
  • Amazon Prime Video enable filmmakers to distribute films directly to audiences worldwide.
  • Artificial intelligence helps in script analysis, editing, visual effects, dubbing, and audience
  • analysis, reducing time and production costs. Virtual production uses technologies such as LED
  • screens and real-time computer graphics to create realistic backgrounds and environments.
  • Immersive media, including virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR), provides interactive
  • and engaging cinematic experiences. These technologies improve creativity, reduce certain
  • production expenses, expand global reach, and create new opportunities for filmmakers. / .
questions.final_answer: production expenses, expand global reach, and create new opportunities for filmmakers
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Analyse how social media marketing can be used to build a start-up brand.
questions.solution_html:
• Social media marketing helps start-ups build brand awareness, attract customers, and establish a
  • strong market presence. Platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and LinkedIn enable
  • start-ups to promote their products and services at a relatively low cost. Creating engaging content
  • including videos, posters, and customer testimonials, helps attract the target audience. Audience
  • targeting allows businesses to reach potential customers based on their interests, age, and location.
  • Influencer collaborations and customer feedback improve brand credibility, while regular
  • interaction builds customer relationships and loyalty. Finally, analysing engagement, reach, and
  • conversions helps start-ups evaluate campaign performance and improve their marketing strategies.
questions.final_answer: conversions helps start-ups evaluate campaign performance and improve their marketing strategies
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: What are the objectives of event marketing?
questions.solution_html:
• The main objectives of event marketing are to create brand awareness, promote products and
  • services, attract potential customers, and increase sales. It also aims to build customer
  • relationships, engage the target audience, generate leads, strengthen brand image, and improve
  • customer loyalty. Events provide opportunities for direct interaction, product demonstrations
  • networking, and collecting audience feedback.The main objectives of event marketing are to:Create
  • brand awareness,Promote products and services,Attract potential customers,Increase sales and
  • revenue,Build customer relationships,Engage the target audience,Generate leads.
questions.final_answer: revenue,Build customer relationships,Engage the target audience,Generate leads
